title: Compatible etale scheme presentation diagram
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F,G$ be presheaves of sets on the category of schemes over $S$, in the test-scheme universes of [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:F\to G$ be a natural transformation. An etale presentation diagram of $f$ consists of schemes $U,V$ over $S$, natural transformations $a:h_U\to F$ and $b:h_V\to G$, and an $S$-morphism $h:U\to V$, such that $a,b$ are representable etale maps in the scheme-test sense of [def-trf-algebraic-space], using etale scheme morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $f\circ a=b\circ h_h$, where $h_h:h_U\to h_V$ is the Yoneda map induced by $h$. Neither chart is required to be surjective. In particular this applies to a morphism of algebraic spaces and to a scheme source via its representable presheaf.
